_doc: Capability slots. Skills ask for a slot, never a product. The user's own mapping lives in <data dir>/connectors.json. 'search' are keywords for finding it among connected tools and the MCP registry.

property-data.label: Property and public-record data
property-data.fallback: none: stop and tell the user to authorize cre-harness

crm.label: CRM / contact database
needs: tags or custom fields for buy box
crm.fallback: cre-harness workspace_* tools, then a CSV in the data dir

email.label: Email
email.fallback: give the text for the user to paste

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.fallback: list dates in the status board

esign.label: E-signature
esign.fallback: none: remind the user to send manually

storage.label: File storage (photos, documents)
needs: read files in a property folder
storage.fallback: local folder path in the profile

contact-data.label: Contact enrichment
needs: emails and phones for people and companies
contact-data.fallback: public record only (no individual owner phones)

listing-platforms.label: Listing and market platforms
listing-platforms.fallback: none: user posts manually; sites like LoopNet block automated reads
